plain_summary_en: This paper studies Does Immersive Journalism Erode News Objectivity? Effects of Immersion on Audience Emotional Engagement and Objectivity Perception. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Objectivity (philosophy), Journalism, Perception, Immersion (mathematics). The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
